claims.statement: Sp=-4p u^2+2sigma_second uv-2v^2 and SK=sigma_second v^2/6-12a u^2 include the known normalized-normal and pullback contributions in the stated first representative.

Each Sp and SK has at least two distinct coefficient zeros in (1.49998,1.49999), with opposite signs at the certified endpoints and at any interior actual scalar zero; no uniqueness or full zero count.
||dSp Y^2||_L2 / ||(-2v^2)Y^2||_L2 <9e-13 in the registered background proper shell measure. No relative pointwise claim at v=0.

Sp and SK project into 1,Z2,H4 with factors1/6,1/2,1. EN is only the retained degree-four Robin coefficient and uses H4 norm factor19pi^2/360; degree-two EN2 is a distinct algebraic formula; no monopole Robin reduction.
D=diag(3,8) symmetrizes the displayed retained Robin matrix; exact registered boxes give eigenvalue lower>0.6677 and determinant>10.691. No full Einstein energy estimate follows.

On D={0<=t<=3ell,z>=0,z+t<=8ell}, the actual-boundary Dirichlet map has contraction upper459/1e9, ||w||<1.001463 and ||w-w0||<4.597e-7 using the exact boundary lift. No differentiated interior jets certified.
Full tensor Einstein/scalar Hessian and relative harmonic source formulas are supplied and cross-checked on two generic exact metric jet sets; no continuous numerical full bulk source is evaluated.
